newsitem.title: USA: TVA Watts Bar power plant prepares startup.
newsitem.headline: TVA Watts Bar power plant prepares startup.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,170 megawatt (MW) Watts Bar nuclear power plant is "in hot standby and preparing for reactor startup," the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The NRC report listed an estimated restart date of January 31 for the unit, but gave no further details.
TVA Nuclear declines as a matter of policy to comment on the operation of its power plants.
The plant, in Spring City, Tenn., tripped off line Friday and went down again Monday when restart was aborted after a leak was discovered in a main condenser tube.
The unit is a main source of baseload electricity to the Southeast U.S.
